heldout.fit: reader fold differs AND sentence fold differs
heldout.predict: reader fold matches AND sentence fold matches

objective.loss: sum of categorical negative log likelihoods

length_transform: log1p Unicode characters and whitespace-delimited words at the visible sentence stop; unique fit stimulus mean and population SD (replace zero SD by 1), divided by sqrt(2)
fixed_hidden_transform: sentence-end FP32 state converted to float64 and row L2-normalized
interaction: two centered group-code coordinates multiplied by the normalized hidden state; shared length, group, and hidden main effects as in the additive readout
blank_background: arithmetic mixture of additive probability vectors using empirical fit-trial group frequencies
